title: Pengaruh Cahaya Dan Perlakuan Benih Terhadap Perkecambahan Benih Pepaya (Carica papaya L.)
why: IPB repository record (opened): four experiments on the effect of light and the seed coat on papaya seed germination (sand under dark and light, intact, partly hulled and naked seeds). The abstract page gives no result and the record lists no DOI; the PDF is in the repository. Would close sense_light_nonvisual for Carica papaya. Buletin Agronomi XV(3).
